name: s-gw
tagline: Local credential control for coding agents.
description: Connect Cline to an existing local s-gw installation over MCP stdio. Discover credential handles, request bounded credential-backed operations, and review requests locally before execution. Install and complete s-gw setup first. This entry was checked against s-gw v0.1.22.

install.notes: Requires an existing s-gw installation on PATH and completed local operator setup. Tested server release: @s-gw/s-gw@0.1.22. Complete the setup in https://github.com/sgateway/s-gw#readme before connecting Cline. Keep credentials and unlock configuration in the existing s-gw setup. Do not paste them into Cline. This stdio connection does not install guard mode or create OS isolation.
